# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Age:** Early twenties  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** University student at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Royal Lisle  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an extraordinarily handsome young man with dark, intent eyes and a smile described as deep, black, and velvety. He possesses a charming, attractive appearance and fine manners.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

## Personality

Cyril is intelligent, refined, and adept at delivering romantic praise and writing poetry. He is devoted to his family, having set aside his education for two years to travel overseas and care for his ill mother. Although polite and esteemed by many, he can exhibit a slightly condescending side or show disdain when rejected.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045), [v3 c38 P49](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0049)_

## History

Cyril completed his Freshman and Sophomore years at Wexcombe before stepping away from his studies for two years to care for his mother during her illness in Europe. Upon returning to Portmaris to complete his Arts degree as a Junior, he encountered Nell Harcourt in a park during a rainstorm, offering her his umbrella. He promptly sent her a dozen long-stemmed roses accompanied by a sentimental poem and began actively courting her. He arranged for his mother and sisters, Dorothy and Aline, to visit Tabby's Place to meet Nell. Eventually, Cyril proposed marriage to Nell, but she rejected him after realizing she did not truly love him, leading to resentment and feelings of humiliation.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 c38 P36](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0036), [v3 c38 P41](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0041), [v3 c38 P49](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0049)_
